intro.title: Nice day to notice the small wins
intro.description: You don't need huge things to feel better. Take a moment to notice one small win today.

breathing.title: Gentle 3-breath reset
breathing.description: Slowly inhale for 3, hold 1, exhale 4 — repeat 6 times.

breathing.title: Box breathing
breathing.description: 4 seconds inhale, 4 hold, 4 exhale, 4 hold — 3 rounds.

breathing.title: Counting breaths
breathing.description: Breathe in/out naturally, count breaths to 10 then start again.

breathing.title: Sigh it out
breathing.description: Take a deep breath and sigh fully — repeat 5 times.

breathing.title: Balloon belly
breathing.description: Place hands on belly, inhale to expand belly, exhale to soften — 5 rounds.

breathing.title: Focus on exhale
breathing.description: Make exhale slightly longer than inhale for 2 minutes.

breathing.title: 4-7-8 mini break
breathing.description: Inhale 4, hold 7, exhale 8 — 4 cycles.

breathing.title: Wakeful breathing
breathing.description: Sit tall — breathe slow and notice sensations for 2 minutes.

breathing.title: Shoulder release
breathing.description: On inhale raise shoulders, on exhale drop them — 6 times.

breathing.title: Visual breath
breathing.description: Imagine breathing in calm color, breathing out tension — 2 minutes.

journaling.title: Gratitude 3
journaling.description: Write three small things that went well today — even tiny wins count.

journaling.title: Highlight of the day
journaling.description: Describe one moment you enjoyed and why it felt good.

journaling.title: What made me smile
journaling.description: List small events that made you smile this week.

journaling.title: Kindness note
journaling.description: Write a short encouraging note to yourself.

journaling.title: Morning intention
journaling.description: Write one thing you want to notice today.

journaling.title: Mini success log
journaling.description: Note a thing you did well today and how it helped.

journaling.title: Sensory check-in
journaling.description: Describe 3 sensory details you noticed recently.

journaling.title: Favorite memory
journaling.description: Jot down a small happy memory & what made it nice.

journaling.title: Compliment list
journaling.description: Write 2 compliments you genuinely mean to yourself.

journaling.title: Small future plan
journaling.description: Write one tiny plan that will add joy this week.

hobby.title: Sketch for 5 mins
hobby.description: Draw a simple flower or shape — no pressure for perfection.

hobby.title: Play a happy tune
hobby.description: Open a song you love and play/sing along for 2 songs.

hobby.title: Make a quick photo
hobby.description: Take one nice phone photo of something pretty nearby.

hobby.title: 10-minute walk
hobby.description: Move outside or around the house and notice the sky.

hobby.title: Try a quick recipe
hobby.description: Make a simple snack — focus on smells and tastes.

hobby.title: Color something
hobby.description: Fill a small doodle with color for 10 minutes.

hobby.title: 1-song dance
hobby.description: Put on a track and dance like nobody’s watching.

hobby.title: Tidy one corner
hobby.description: Clear a small corner — quick wins boost mood.

hobby.title: Listen to a podcast clip
hobby.description: Find a calming short clip (5–10 min).

hobby.title: Call a friend for 3 min
hobby.description: Send a voice note or quick hello to someone you like.

intro.title: It's okay to have days like this
intro.description: Let’s take a small step to feel a bit lighter.

breathing.title: Gentle Breathing
breathing.description: Try a 3-minute calming session.

breathing.title: Long exhale
breathing.description: Make exhale longer than inhale for 2 minutes.

breathing.title: Counting calming breaths
breathing.description: Count each breath to keep you grounded.

breathing.title: Hand on chest
breathing.description: Breathe with hand on chest to feel the rise and fall.

breathing.title: Soothing rhythm
breathing.description: Inhale 3, exhale 5 — repeat 8 times.

breathing.title: Breath + body scan
breathing.description: Breathe slowly then scan and soften tense spots.

breathing.title: Box breathing (gentle)
breathing.description: 4-4-4-4 but at a relaxed pace.

breathing.title: Rescue breath
breathing.description: Deep inhale, slow exhale — 5 rounds.

breathing.title: Warm breath imagery
breathing.description: Imagine warmth on exhale — calm down.

breathing.title: Ocean breath
breathing.description: Use a soft ‘shh’ on the exhale — repeat 6 times.

journaling.title: Name the feeling
journaling.description: Write the emotion in one word and why you think it's here.

journaling.title: Small comfort
journaling.description: Write one comforting thing you can do right now.

journaling.title: What helps before bed
journaling.description: List 3 things that make nights easier for you.

journaling.title: Letter to self
journaling.description: Write a short compassionate letter to yourself.

journaling.title: Unload list
journaling.description: Pour out whatever’s on your mind for 5 minutes.

journaling.title: Track one trigger
journaling.description: Note what event preceded the sadness.

journaling.title: Tiny step plan
journaling.description: Write one tiny action that may ease the mood.

journaling.title: Memory of comfort
journaling.description: Describe a memory that felt safe or warm.

journaling.title: If I could say to a friend
journaling.description: Write what you'd tell a friend in your situation.

journaling.title: Mood temperature
journaling.description: Rate how heavy the feeling is 1–10 and what would move it 1 pt.

hobby.title: Make a cup of tea
hobby.description: Focus on smell and warmth for 5 minutes.

hobby.title: Look at old photos
hobby.description: Browse a few photos that feel safe or funny.

hobby.title: Short walk near greenery
hobby.description: Move outside if possible — notice air and sounds.

hobby.title: Listen to a comfort song
hobby.description: Play a track that soothes you for 5–10 minutes.

hobby.title: Simple craft
hobby.description: Fold paper, arrange flowers, make something small.

hobby.title: Cook a tiny recipe
hobby.description: Follow one simple recipe — focus on senses.

hobby.title: Gentle stretching
hobby.description: Do 5 minutes of slow stretches.

hobby.title: Coloring page
hobby.description: Color a pre-made shape — no need to finish.

hobby.title: Warm bath or shower
hobby.description: Use warm water and a simple scent if available.

hobby.title: Short call to a kind person
hobby.description: Reach out briefly — you don’t need to explain everything.

intro.title: Small steps when worry is loud
intro.description: Focus on grounding: a single tiny action can change your state.

breathing.title: Grounding breath
breathing.description: Inhale 4, hold 2, exhale 6 — repeat 6 times.

breathing.title: 4-4-4 calming
breathing.description: Steady rhythm counting for 2 minutes.

breathing.title: Alternate nostril (gentle)
breathing.description: 4 cycles— only if feels comfortable.

breathing.title: Progressive breath
breathing.description: Combine breath with progressive muscle relax.

breathing.title: Slow breathe with focus
breathing.description: Count breaths while paying attention to feet on ground.

breathing.title: Exhale with hiss
breathing.description: Short inhale — long hiss exhale — 6 times.

breathing.title: Box breathing short
breathing.description: 4 seconds each side — 3 rounds.

breathing.title: Mindful inhale
breathing.description: Notice where air passes in body on inhale/exhale.

breathing.title: Relax shoulders
breathing.description: On exhale drop and relax shoulders — repeat 8 times.

breathing.title: Breathe + anchor word
breathing.description: On exhale say a calming word silently.

journaling.title: Worry list
journaling.description: Write each worry for 2 minutes then close the list.

journaling.title: What’s realistic?
journaling.description: Pick a worry and write one action to reduce it.

journaling.title: Five senses anchor
journaling.description: Describe 1 thing from each sense right now.

journaling.title: If this worry had advice
journaling.description: Write what the worry would say, then reply kindly.

journaling.title: Small planning
journaling.description: Write the next tiny step for any problem — one line.

journaling.title: Success evidence
journaling.description: List times you handled similar worry before.

journaling.title: Unhook from thoughts
journaling.description: Write ‘I am having the thought that...’ and finish one sentence.

journaling.title: Time-box worry
journaling.description: Schedule 10 minutes later and jot what you’ll focus on then.

journaling.title: Breath log
journaling.description: Note how breathing changed after 2 minutes of calm breath.

journaling.title: Gratitude micro
journaling.description: Name one small thing that’s okay in this moment.

hobby.title: Quick grounding walk
hobby.description: Notice three things you can see and two you can touch.

hobby.title: Squeeze stress ball
hobby.description: 5 squeezes and slow release — repeat a couple times.

hobby.title: Make a small snack
hobby.description: Focus on simple steps of making it, no rush.

hobby.title: Gentle yoga sequence
hobby.description: Try 5 gentle poses to release tension.

hobby.title: Listen to a focused soundscape
hobby.description: Find a 5-minute calming sound and listen fully.

hobby.title: Organize a tiny space
hobby.description: Clear one drawer or shelf for a sense of control.

hobby.title: Short creative prompt
hobby.description: Write one silly line of creative text and stop.

hobby.title: Play with a pet or plant
hobby.description: Give attention without pressure.

hobby.title: Mindful tea/coffee
hobby.description: Slowly prepare and sip while noticing details.

hobby.title: Breath + doodle
hobby.description: Breathe calmly and draw a repeating pattern for 5 minutes.

intro.title: Gentle care when you’re drained
intro.description: Small, simple choices can restore a little energy — let’s try one.

breathing.title: Slow belly breaths
breathing.description: 5 slow belly breaths to soften the body.

breathing.title: Short energizing breath
breathing.description: 3 quick breaths then a long exhale — repeat 3 times.

breathing.title: Yawning breath
breathing.description: Fake yawn to trigger relaxing reflex, then breathe easy.

breathing.title: Wakeful stretch + breath
breathing.description: Stretch arms on inhale, lower on exhale — 6 times.

breathing.title: Gentle 2-minute reset
breathing.description: Soft inhale/exhale rhythm while seated tall.

breathing.title: Soft counting
breathing.description: Breathe in 4 out 6 — focus on slowing down.

breathing.title: Shoulder roll + breath
breathing.description: Roll shoulders with slow breaths — 5 times.

breathing.title: Cooling breath
breathing.description: Open mouth exhale softly, imagine cool air return.

breathing.title: Refresh inhale
breathing.description: Deep inhale through nose, hold a second, exhale slowly.

breathing.title: Seated grounding
breathing.description: Feet planted, breathe and notice points of contact.

journaling.title: Rest list
journaling.description: Write 3 small restful things you can do right now.

journaling.title: Two-minute brain dump
journaling.description: Empty your head on paper without editing.

journaling.title: Gratitude for rest
journaling.description: Name one restful experience from today or yesterday.

journaling.title: Energy check
journaling.description: Note what saps and what mildly restores you.

journaling.title: Short plan to recharge
journaling.description: Write one tiny thing that will help you feel less tired.

journaling.title: Sleep friendly note
journaling.description: List one habit that could make sleep better tonight.

journaling.title: Mini mindfulness
journaling.description: Describe your breath for 1 minute on paper.

journaling.title: Favorite cozy moment
journaling.description: Write the last time you felt cozy and why.

journaling.title: Tiny boundary
journaling.description: Write one thing you can say No to today for energy.

journaling.title: Small win log
journaling.description: Write something you did that didn’t drain you today.

hobby.description: 5 minutes of light stretching to wake the body.

hobby.title: Listen to calming music
hobby.description: Sit and listen to a short track while closing eyes.

hobby.title: Easy sipping ritual
hobby.description: Make a warm drink and sip slowly noticing warmth.

hobby.title: Light walk outdoors
hobby.description: Short slow walk to bring gentle movement.

hobby.description: Spend 2 minutes looking at a pleasant photo.

hobby.title: Read a 1-page story
hobby.description: Pick a short excerpt that’s soothing.

hobby.description: Change into something that helps you relax.
